|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 3 of 4) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Dathomir: Maul's Chambers (ALT) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee high-resolution card image of this version ([[:File:V13-D-dathomirmaulschambers_ai-2024-02-24-hires.png]]); no card-size GIF of this image was ever committed, which is why it was missing from the version list until the PC's high-resolution images were compared with the card-size images (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Each version below is a published PC printing; card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Every visibly different printing is a separate version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026); a later copy of the same image in another format is not (13 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 24 February 2024<ref name="img-altpng-d660492-dathomirmaulschambersaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/dathomirmaulschambers_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d660492911547170d55af7c4f2a7d4aad605ec2a commit d660492] (24 February 2024) (“2023 and 2024 Alternate Images”). No card-size GIF of this image was committed (the card-size image <code>large/…</code> was never made from it); the PC served this PNG at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/dathomirmaulschambers_ai.png until it was replaced (today's copy is the latest version only), and GEMP showed the high-resolution image.</ref>. The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; label “(AI)”; bottom margin “Dark Hours”. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Jar Jar and your spies (except Ezra) may not deploy here. Opponent may not Force drain here.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dathomir: Maul's Chambers (ALT) (Errata)]]): '''What changed''' (compared with the previous version, the high-resolution image of 24 February 2024): the label “(AI)” → “(ALT)”. PC card image uploaded 20 January 2026<ref name="img-altpng-6cae8c9-large">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/dathomirmaulschambers_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6cae8c9ca0ffa879985fee5c01eca246364add0d commit 6cae8c9] (20 January 2026); the PC serves the latest version of each file at res.starwarsccg.org/cards/. The commit date is the upload date.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; label “(ALT)”; bottom margin “Dark Hours”. It is the current image. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Jar Jar and your spies (except Ezra) may not deploy here. Opponent may not Force drain here.”
